name: J. P. Mahaffy
bio: Classical scholar (1839-1919), Wilde's tutor at Trinity College Dublin and later its Provost. He took Wilde to Greece in 1877, and Wilde corrected the proofs of his Rambles and Studies in Greece and made 'improvements and corrections all through' an earlier book, Social Life in Greece from Homer to Menander (1874), for which Mahaffy thanked him by name in the preface. Social Life contained a discussion of Greek homosexuality. In later editions both that discussion and the thanks to Wilde were removed.
bio_note: The editors state it flatly at printed 28: 'Significantly, in later editions of Social Life both the discussion of Greek homosexuality and the reference to Wilde were dropped.' Two letters; the later (1893) one is quoted here, the earlier is at PDF 613-14.
